method: Values the reference provider published for each stock, collected from web-search result titles/snippets of the reference site term pages and the reference provider news articles (the reference site itself returns HTTP 403 to automated clients; archive.org was unreachable). Each value carries its as-of date and source URL. Undated values and values older than 2026-01 are listed under 'excluded'. Extended on 2026-10-10 with Fair Values (and the quoted price) for 59 more S&P 500 stocks, from the same kind of search snippets; dates given as 'N days ago' were converted to calendar dates and marked lower confidence.
